description: KIOS and OpenWaterAnalytics provide MATLAB wrappers for viewing, editing, simulating and plotting EPANET networks. The repository documents toolkit and MSX interfaces, a conference tutorial and current software requirements. This resource is provided by OpenWaterAnalytics (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: EUPL-1.2. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The README requires MATLAB R2024a or later and EPANET 2.3. MATLAB availability is separate from the toolkit's EUPL licence. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
